notes: Single golden croissant on a seamless white background, square, soft shadow. Reads like a cut-out, so it sits cleanly in the circular hero and the 56px thumb and fills about 75% of the crop. Runner-up: croissant on a cork coaster against a warm cream backdrop, centered, matches the palette.

Top-down shot of two avocado toasts and lemon slices on a round white plate. The plate is centered and the circle crop follows its rim, like the pizza-on-plate reference. Neutral light grey surface, a little cool. Runner-up: 3/4 view of a toast on a speckled cream plate, brighter and more appetizing, but topped with blueberries and feta.

Fried egg and bacon on a toasted sesame bun, on a white plate, warm wood table, side/3/4 view. Centered, fills about 65% width. There is a soft blurred figure in the top background that the circle mostly crops out. Runner-up: square shot of a seeded bagel sandwich with cheese on a round wooden board, warm palette, centered (filling looks more lettuce/avocado than egg).

Banana bread slices with walnuts on a round sage plate over warm wood, slightly overhead. The plate is centered and the slices stay inside the circle. Warm but slightly yellow white balance. Runner-up: glazed banana-bread loaf end with banana chips on white parchment, bright and premium. It sits left of center, so a centered square crop clips its left edge.

Gooey chocolate-chunk cookie on parchment, close-up, warm, sharp. The cookie fills the circle (other cookies peek in at the edges). Runner-up: single chocolate chip cookie top-down, centered on crinkled white parchment. Very clean for a circle, a little cooler and greyer.

Basque burnt cheesecake slice, side view, on white parchment against a bright white/cream background, square. The caramelized top and creamy interior read well, and the slice fills about 80% width. Other slices are blurred in the background. Runner-up: classic burnt basque slice on a wooden tray, authentic but on a mid-grey, moodier background. The subject sits in the lower half of a portrait frame.

Stack of three crackle-top fudgy brownies on white parchment, bright, warm brown. The stack is center-left of a portrait frame and fits within a centered square crop. More brownies sit around the edges. Runner-up: brownie stack with chocolate chips on a round white plate with raspberries, 3/4 overhead, centered. Very appetizing, but it adds red and teal (napkin) accents.

Square tiramisu portion dusted with cocoa on a ribbed white plate, slightly overhead. The plate is centered and nearly fills the square crop. The background is a striped wood-grain table (light grey/brown). Runner-up: round tiramisu tied with twine on a cream plate, warm and cozy with a mug in the blurred background. The subject sits low in a portrait frame, so it needs object-position bottom or it gets cut.

BANNER: overhead rows of glossy golden croissants on baking parchment. Warm and bright, a repeating pattern that survives any banner crop (landscape 6000x4000). Runner-up: bakery tray of pain au chocolat with egg tarts and buns behind. More of a varied 'spread / counter', warm, slightly busier with a cool corner.

BANNER: bright minimal café with a light-wood counter and stools, warm wood ceiling, and an espresso bar. A barista is small in the background, not dominant (landscape 16:9). Runner-up: airy cream café with paper lanterns, a long communal table and a sofa, warm golden tone. Small distant patrons.
